disruptions.description: Flight cancelled by carrier before departure due to unscheduled technical aircraft maintenance. No immediate automatic rebooking offered.
IndiGo flight 6E-204 from BLR to DEL scheduled at 07:00 AM cancelled at 05:15 AM due to unscheduled technical aircraft maintenance. No automatic rebooking provided at counter.
Tejas Express 22119 halted near Ratnagiri due to automated signal system breakdown. Delay estimated at 3 hours, pushing Madgaon arrival past 17:40 PM.
Dense morning fog at Delhi IGI Airport triggered low visibility procedures. Flight AI-512 held on ground for 4 hours, missing the Alleppey Houseboat 13:00 cast-off.
